title: .NET Framework 1.0 ships with Visual Studio .NET 2002
impact: Business apps can be built on managed code with ADO.NET, Windows Forms and ASP.NET instead of VB6/COM, but every client and server needs the runtime installed

title: C# 1.0 ships with Visual Studio .NET 2002
impact: A new C-style language becomes available for business apps on .NET; teams have to choose between C# and VB.NET for new systems

title: Visual Basic .NET (VB 7.0) ships with Visual Studio .NET 2002
impact: VB6 code does not carry over as is; moving to VB.NET means a rewrite or a wizard upgrade followed by manual fixes
